prompt: In-place binary updates restart a node in place, keeping its listener bound so in-flight requests only queue briefly. Yet the deploy still gossips that node out of the cluster and back, evicting and later republishing its routing/provider records under a long repair grace — needless churn for a node that never actually departed. It also means a failed swap can leave the node stuck mid-transition instead of healthy. Change the in-place update path so it avoids this unnecessary cluster dance. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: stepdown before swap in rolling deploy
node state transitions during deploy Active to Deploying
repair grace and provider record republish churn
which deploy strategies need to drain the load balancer
_subject: deploy: skip DHT stepdown for in-place SSM binary updates (#1886)
